title: Citrus flavanone metabolites protect pancreatic beta-cells against cholesterol stress through a multi-proteomic mechanism.
authors: Fraga, Layanne Nascimento; Anacleto, Sara Lima; Milenkovic, Dragan; Lajolo, Franco Maria; Hassimotto, Neuza Mariko Aymoto
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白质组学和分子对接研究柑橘黄烷酮代谢物对胰岛β细胞的保护机制，虽涉及转录因子对接但非核心TF-DNA互作建模，方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度不足。
abstract: Citrus flavanones may improve oxidative stress and insulin resistance induced by western diets. However, there is a paucity of studies investigating the change in protein expression levels. This study evaluated the protection and the mechanisms of action of citrus flavanone metabolites, hesperetin 7-glucuronide (H7G) and 3-(4'-hydroxyphenyl) propanoic acid (PA), on pancreatic beta-cell function under oxidative stress induced by cholesterol using the global proteomics approach. Cholesterol induced changes in the global proteomic profile in the pancreatic beta-cell line Min6. On the other hand, proteomics analysis identified 254 proteins differentially expressed with H7G and 352 with PA treatments, most of them were opposite to the changes induced by cholesterol. Bioinformatics analysis showed that these proteins are implicated in cell functions like cell signaling (insulin signaling, p30MAPK signaling, and others), metabolism (glucokinase and glutathione metabolisms), and inflammation pathways (TNF-alpha and NF-kappaB pathways). Also, the results of molecular docking suggest that H7G and PA could bind to putative transcription factors (PPAR-gamma, STAT-3, CREB1, NF-kappaB, NFYA) and cell signaling proteins (IKK, RAS, Pi3K, ERK), which results in changes in protein expression observed. Altogether, these data suggest that the treatment with H7G and PA protects pancreatic beta-cells against stress induced by cholesterol through multi-proteomic mechanisms of action.
abstract_zh: 柑橘黄烷酮可能改善西方饮食诱导的氧化应激和胰岛素抵抗。然而，关于蛋白质表达水平变化的研究尚显不足。本研究采用全局蛋白质组学方法，评估了柑橘黄烷酮代谢物——橙皮素7-葡萄糖醛酸苷（H7G）和3-(4'-羟基苯基)丙酸（PA）——在胆固醇诱导的氧化应激下对胰腺β细胞功能的保护作用及其作用机制。胆固醇在胰腺β细胞系Min6中诱导了全局蛋白质组谱的变化。另一方面，蛋白质组学分析鉴定出，H7G处理下有254种蛋白质差异表达，PA处理下有352种蛋白质差异表达，其中大多数与胆固醇诱导的变化方向相反。生物信息学分析显示，这些蛋白质涉及细胞功能，如细胞信号传导（胰岛素信号传导、p30MAPK信号传导等）、代谢（葡萄糖激酶和谷胱甘肽代谢）以及炎症通路（TNF-α和NF-κB通路）。此外，分子对接结果表明，H7G和PA可能结合到假定的转录因子（PPAR-γ、STAT-3、CREB1、NF-κB、NFYA）和细胞信号蛋白（IKK、RAS、Pi3K、ERK）上，从而导致观察到的蛋白质表达变化。综上所述，这些数据表明，H7G和PA处理通过多种蛋白质组学作用机制，保护胰腺β细胞免受胆固醇诱导的应激损伤。
